principle: Close capability gaps with the smallest shared safe repair supported by evidence; never weaken tests or claim mastery without passing evidence.

strategies.repair: repair capability-to-route mapping and add route-selection regression fixtures

strategies.gap: tool exists but Buddy cannot find/use it
strategies.repair: normalize registry metadata, permissions, schemas, and discovery tests
strategies.measure: tool discovery rate, valid invocation rate, failure recovery

strategies.repair: add runtime binding contract and smoke test

strategies.gap: context loss or poor task continuity
strategies.repair: shared context/state fixture with bounded retention and replay tests
add plan decomposition, checkpoints, dependency ordering, and recovery fixtures
strategies.measure: completion, unnecessary steps, retries, elapsed time

strategies.repair: add domain-appropriate verifier and evidence requirements
improve shared rubric, generation constraints, and quality feedback loop
cache safe deterministic work, reduce redundant calls, batch independent operations
budget-aware routing, deduplication, early stopping after sufficient evidence
strategies.measure: calls/task, tokens where available, resource use

strategies.repair: isolate nondeterminism, add retries only where safe, strengthen fixtures
shared policy gate, deny-by-default sensitive actions, safety regression suite
strategies.measure: safety pass rate, blocked unsafe actions

strategies.repair: identify external dependency, create native fallback/skill where feasible, label assisted results

strategies.gap: benchmark failure does not improve future behavior
strategies.repair: persist failure diagnosis, strategy, evidence, and regression fixture in learning store
version fixtures/rubrics, deterministic seeds where appropriate, evidence schema and baseline
generate capability-to-suite coverage map and add smallest representative fixture
strategies.measure: coverage percentage and uncovered critical capabilities

strategies.gap: many bots fail for same reason
strategies.repair: patch shared framework/service once and retest every dependent suite
strategies.measure: number of failures removed per shared change

strategies.repair: expand dependency-aware regression set and require before/after comparison

strategies.gap: next failure is predictable but not prepared for
strategies.repair: rank capability leads by evidence, impact, recurrence, and feasibility
strategies.measure: forecast precision and lead closure rate

strategies.gap: working capability cannot be discovered by users
strategies.repair: generate public-safe prospectus, examples, limitations, and evidence link

strategies.gap: verified system is difficult to obtain/run
strategies.repair: validate release artifacts, startup diagnostics, platform checks, and rollback path

optimization_rule: Optimize quality first, then speed and efficiency without reducing required evidence or safety gates.
parallelization_rule: Independent benchmark cases may be batched or parallelized inside the single workflow; dependent repair/test chains remain ordered.
mastery_rule: A gap is mastered only when passing evidence meets its benchmark-specific quality/correctness/reliability/safety gates and remains reproducible.
